FEAT-AI-REVIEW-RUBRICS.name: 评阅模板与客观检查项
FEAT-AI-REVIEW-RUBRICS.description: 系统内置学术型博士自然科学、学术型博士人文社科、专业型博士、学术型硕士和专业型硕士五类模板。\n每类模板定义必需章节和最低参考文献数量；共享客观分值为章节完整性 30 分、参考文献数量与编号 20 分、研究方法章节 20 分、结论章节 20 分、规范检测结果 10 分。\n客观分不低于 80 且无必需章节缺失时结果为“基础检查通过”，否则为“需修改”。

FEAT-DUPLICATION-DETECT.name: 发起本地相似度与风险检测

visual_reference.label: 创新性分析上传信息界面
visual_reference.analysis:
### 1. Frontend Style Direction
* **Colors:** Deep navy header (`#1F3B5D` / `#203A5A`), primary blue action color (`#3D8BF2`), pale blue upload accents (`#B7CAE6`), white page background, light gray input borders (`#DADADA`), muted placeholder text (`#C8C8C8`), dark label/body text (`#333333`).
* **Typography:** Clean sans-serif Chinese UI font. Header title is large and bold around 24–28px. Form labels around 16px medium weight. Input placeholders around 15–16px in light gray. Primary CTA text around 22–24px bold.
* **Spacing Rhythm:** Medium-spacious layout with generous horizontal margins. Upload area has large vertical padding. Form grid uses two columns with wide central gap and consistent row spacing around 28–32px.
* **Overall Tone:** Minimal enterprise-style document upload workflow for an AI analysis tool; clean, structured, and task-focused.

### 2. Page Skeleton (Top to Bottom)

* **Section Name:** Top Header
* **Purpose:** Establish page context for document upload.
* **Container:** Full-width horizontal bar, fixed height around 64px, dark navy background.
* **Children:** Left-aligned page title text “文档上传”.
* **Style Notes:** Title is white, bold, vertically centered, with left padding around 28–32px. No visible navigation, icons, or secondary actions.

* **Section Name:** Main Content Area
* **Purpose:** Hosts upload drop zone and metadata input controls.
* **Container:** Full-width white canvas with inner horizontal padding around 36–40px and top padding around 30px.
* **Children:** Upload drop zone followed by two-column form grid.
* **Style Notes:** Layout is flat with no card shadow; visual grouping relies on spacing and component borders.

* **Section Name:** Upload Drop Zone
* **Purpose:** Primary file input surface for selecting or dragging documents.
* **Container:** Wide rounded rectangle occupying nearly full content width; height around 150px; white background; dashed pale-blue border; corner radius around 22–26px.
* **Children:** Centered vertical stack: circular upload icon button, bold instruction text, secondary helper text.
* **Style Notes:** Upload icon is centered inside a light-blue outlined circle. Dashed border communicates drag-and-drop behavior. Text hierarchy emphasizes the upload instruction over file-type helper text.

* **Section Name:** Metadata Form Grid
* **Purpose:** Collects classification and analysis metadata before submission.
* **Container:** Two-column grid beneath upload zone. Left and right columns are visually balanced; labels sit to the left of controls within each column row.
* **Children:** 
  * Row 1: “一级学科” selector/input on left, “二级学科” selector/input on right.
  * Row 2: “研究方向” text input on left, “关键词” text input on right.
  * Row 3: “学历层次” radio group on left, primary submit button on right.
* **Style Notes:** Labels have fixed width and align vertically with controls. Inputs are rectangular with subtle radius around 4–6px. Controls use consistent height around 44–48px. Bottom action aligns with right-column input width.

### 3. Data Presentation Style

* **Pattern Type:** Upload form with metadata fields; no table, list, chart, or record display is present.
* **Visual Structure:** Single upload drop zone plus structured form fields. Future runtime data should populate placeholders, selected options, validation states, and uploaded-file feedback rather than hardcoded sample content.
* **Field Types:** Document file, primary discipline/category selector, secondary discipline/category selector, research direction text/tags, keyword text/tags, education-level radio choice.
* **Styling Rules:** 
  * Select/input fields use left-aligned text, light gray placeholders, thin gray borders, and white backgrounds.
  * Multi-value text fields should visually support delimiter-based or tag-style entry while preserving the same input footprint.
  * Radio options display horizontally with circular indicators; selected state uses primary blue fill and clear contrast.
  * Uploaded-file state should appear within or near the drop zone using filename, file status, and removable/replaceable affordance without changing the overall hierarchy.
* **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** Do not seed future screens with screenshot-specific file names, categories, directions, keywords, or analysis results.

### 4. Interaction Surfaces
* **Upload Drop Zone:** Supports click-to-select and drag-and-drop. Use hover/focus states with stronger blue border or subtle tinted background.
* **Text Inputs / Selectors:** Include placeholder text, focus border in primary blue, disabled/error states, and consistent control height.
* **Radio Group:** Two horizontal options under the education-level label. Selected option uses blue ring/fill; unselected option uses gray outline.
* **Primary Button:** Large full-width button within the right form column labeled “AI 创新性分析”; solid blue background, white bold text, rounded corners around 6–8px.
* **Validation Feedback:** Show inline errors below relevant fields or near the upload zone, using compact red text and preserving grid alignment.
* **Loading Feedback:** On submit, button should support loading/disabled state while retaining its size to prevent layout shift.

### 5. Frontend Requirements Summary
* **Must Preserve:** Dark navy title bar, large dashed upload zone, centered upload icon/instruction stack, two-column metadata form, left-side labels, consistent input sizing, and prominent blue CTA button.
* **Runtime-Driven Areas:** Uploaded document state, discipline options, selected education level, research direction entries, keyword entries, validation messages, and submission/loading states.
* **Avoid:** Hardcoding screenshot-specific business content, uploaded-file examples, actual analysis data, category values, keywords, or user-entered metadata as mock records.

visual_reference.label: 创新性分析处理进度
visual_reference.analysis:
### 1. Frontend Style Direction
* **Colors:** Use a clean light interface with a pale blue-gray page/header background (`#eef3f8` approx), white main content surface, dark navy title text (`#0b3768`), muted gray section labels (`#8b8f98`), success green as the dominant state color (`#43c63a` / `#35b934`), and light success fill backgrounds (`#edf9ef`). Connector arrows/dividers should be light gray (`#cfd3d8`).
* **Typography:** Sans-serif Chinese UI font stack. Page title is large and bold, around 24–28px. Section labels are medium-large, around 22–24px, regular weight, muted. Step labels are around 20–22px, regular to medium. Final/active completion text and progress percentage are bold.
* **Spacing Rhythm:** Spacious horizontal process layout with generous vertical separation between stages. Main content uses approximately 20–24px side padding, 32–48px vertical gaps between rows, and consistent 28–40px gaps between step pills including connector arrows.
* **Overall Tone:** Lightweight enterprise workflow/progress dashboard focused on completion state, clarity, and confidence.

### 2. Page Skeleton (Top to Bottom)
* **Section Name:** Page Header
* **Purpose:** Identify the process/progress page.
* **Container:** Full-width horizontal band, pale blue-gray background, fixed-height around 52px, left-aligned content.
* **Children:** Page title text.
* **Style Notes:** Title uses dark navy, bold weight, aligned near the top-left with minimal left padding. No visible actions or navigation.

* **Section Name:** Main Content Area
* **Purpose:** Display multi-stage processing progress and overall completion.
* **Container:** Full-width white or near-white content area, vertically stacked layout, no card border, no shadow.
* **Children:** First process stage row -> second process stage row -> overall progress row.
* **Style Notes:** Content is left-aligned, with large whitespace. Layout should feel dashboard-like but minimal.

* **Section Name:** First Stage Process Row
* **Purpose:** Show sequential file-processing steps.
* **Container:** Vertical group containing a muted stage heading and a horizontal flow row.
* **Children:** Stage heading -> step pill -> arrow connector -> step pill -> arrow connector -> step pill -> arrow connector -> step pill.
* **Style Notes:** Step pills are rounded rectangles, light green fill, green border, black/dark text, and a checkmark prefix. Connectors are thin right arrows centered vertically between pills.

* **Section Name:** Second Stage Process Row
* **Purpose:** Show sequential innovation-analysis steps and final completion state.
* **Container:** Vertical group matching the first stage, with a heading and horizontal flow row.
* **Children:** Stage heading -> multiple completed/in-progress-looking step pills -> arrow connectors -> final completion pill.
* **Style Notes:** Regular steps use the same outlined light-green pill style. Final completion uses a solid green fill with white bold text and checkmark, visually stronger than the previous steps.

* **Section Name:** Overall Progress Row
* **Purpose:** Summarize total workflow completion.
* **Container:** Horizontal row with a left label and a long progress bar occupying most remaining width.
* **Children:** Label -> progress bar track/fill with centered percentage text.
* **Style Notes:** Progress bar is fully filled green, rectangular with small radius around 6–8px. Percentage text is centered, white, bold, around 22–26px.

### 3. Data Presentation Style
* **Pattern Type:** Sequential workflow/progress tracker.
* **Visual Structure:** Two labeled process lanes stacked vertically. Each lane contains horizontally arranged step nodes connected by arrows. The final node in the last lane is rendered as the dominant success/completion state.
* **Field Types:** Future runtime data should provide stage names, ordered step labels, step status, completion state, and overall percentage.
* **Styling Rules:** Completed or active-success steps use green border and pale green background with a checkmark indicator. Terminal completed state uses solid green background and white text. Step labels should remain horizontally centered inside fixed/min-width rounded pills. Long labels should either increase pill width moderately or truncate gracefully with tooltip support.
* **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** The displayed workflow labels should be treated as structural examples; implementation should render stage/step names from runtime configuration or state.

* **Pattern Type:** Linear progress bar.
* **Visual Structure:** Label at left, full-width progress track to the right, filled according to completion percentage.
* **Field Types:** Overall completion percentage and optional status state.
* **Styling Rules:** Fill color should match success green. Percentage text should be centered inside the bar and remain readable against the fill. For incomplete states, the unfilled track should be very light gray or pale green.

### 4. Interaction Surfaces
* No explicit user input controls, filters, tabs, pagination, or dialogs are visible.
* The primary interaction surface is informational status display rather than direct manipulation.
* Step pills may be implemented as non-clickable status nodes unless product behavior requires drill-down.
* If made interactive, hover/focus states should preserve the green success theme with subtle border darkening, tooltip support, and accessible focus outlines.
* Progress bar should be read-only and aria-friendly, exposing current percentage and process label to assistive technologies.

### 5. Frontend Requirements Summary
* **Must Preserve:** Two-stage vertical hierarchy, horizontal connected step flow, pale outlined success pills, stronger solid-green final completion pill, muted stage headings, and full-width overall progress bar.
* **Runtime-Driven Areas:** Stage headings, ordered step labels, step statuses, final completion state, connector count, and overall percentage must come from application state/configuration.
* **Avoid:** Hardcoding screenshot-specific workflow wording, percentages, or process state as mock business data. Use the image only to define layout, visual hierarchy, component styling, and progress-display behavior.

visual_reference.label: 创新性分析完成结果操作
visual_reference.analysis:
### 1. Frontend Style Direction
* **Colors:** Light enterprise palette. Page header uses very pale blue-gray `#edf3f8`; main background white/off-white `#ffffff/#fafafa`. Primary action blue `#3b86f4`; secondary success action green `#27ae68`; neutral outline button border gray `#9a9a9a`. Text uses dark navy/black `#1f2933`; labels use muted gray `#8b929a`; highlighted duration/status value uses orange `#e87822`.
* **Typography:** Sans-serif Chinese UI font stack. Page title around 24–28px, bold, navy. Metadata labels around 20–22px, regular. Values around 22–24px, bold. Buttons around 22–24px, bold for filled actions and medium for outline action.
* **Spacing Rhythm:** Spacious. Large vertical separation between header, info panel, and action row. Info panel has generous internal padding around 36–44px horizontally and 28–34px vertically. Button row uses wide horizontal gaps.
* **Overall Tone:** Clean government/academic enterprise result page with strong action affordances and minimal distractions.

### 2. Page Skeleton (Top to Bottom)
* **Section Name:** Page Header
  * **Purpose:** Identifies the current result page.
  * **Container:** Full-width horizontal band, height about 56px, pale blue-gray background.
  * **Children:** Left-aligned page title “分析结果”.
  * **Style Notes:** Title has strong navy emphasis, bold weight, aligned about 30px from the left. Header is flat, no visible shadow.

* **Section Name:** Result Metadata Card
  * **Purpose:** Shows summary attributes for the completed analysis task.
  * **Container:** Wide centered card below header, nearly full viewport width with side margins around 36px. White/light background, subtle gray border `#e0e0e0`, rounded corners around 8–10px.
  * **Children:** Two-column metadata grid.
    * Left column contains label-value rows for document name, education level, and analysis completion time.
    * Right column contains label-value rows for person name, upload time, and AI analysis duration.
  * **Style Notes:** Labels are muted gray and consistently aligned. Values are bold and dark. The duration value is orange to indicate a special metric. Rows have large vertical spacing, roughly 42–55px. Columns are balanced with a large center gutter.

* **Section Name:** Action Area
  * **Purpose:** Provides next-step operations after analysis completion.
  * **Container:** Full-width white area below metadata card. Horizontally centered button group with large spacing.
  * **Children:** Three sibling buttons:
    * Primary filled button: “创新性分析结果预览”.
    * Success filled button: “创新性分析结果下载”.
    * Neutral outline button: “更多创新性分析记录”.
  * **Style Notes:** Buttons are large rounded rectangles, approximately 440px wide and 100px tall. Filled buttons use white bold text. Outline button uses white background, gray border, dark gray text. Buttons have rounded corners around 12–14px and no heavy shadow.

### 3. Data Presentation Style
* **Pattern Type:** Read-only metadata summary card.
* **Visual Structure:** Two-column label-value grid with three rows per column. Labels appear first in muted gray; values appear to the right, bold and darker. Certain metric/status-like values may use accent color.
* **Field Types:** Future runtime values should include document/file name, user/person identity field, education or category field, upload timestamp, completion timestamp, and processing duration.
* **Styling Rules:** Keep labels visually lighter than values. Align labels consistently within each column. Long filenames should remain on one line when possible; otherwise truncate with ellipsis rather than wrapping into multiple lines. Timestamps should use bold dark text. Processing duration or performance metric should use orange accent.
* **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** All metadata values shown in the card should be populated dynamically from runtime analysis result data.

### 4. Interaction Surfaces
* **Primary Button:** Filled blue, large rounded rectangle, used for previewing the analysis result. Highest priority action alongside download.
* **Secondary Positive Button:** Filled green, same size and typography as primary, used for downloading the result.
* **Tertiary Navigation Button:** White outline button with gray border, same size but lower visual emphasis, used to navigate to more analysis records.
* **Button Layout:** Three buttons appear in one horizontal row on desktop, centered with generous gaps. On smaller widths, they should stack vertically or wrap while preserving equal sizing and spacing.
* **Feedback States:** Filled buttons should support hover darkening, active pressed state, disabled muted state, and loading state for preview/download actions.

### 5. Frontend Requirements Summary
* **Must Preserve:** Pale header band, bold navy page title, bordered metadata card, two-column label-value summary layout, large spacious buttons, blue/green/outline action hierarchy, and orange emphasis for duration-like metric.
* **Runtime-Driven Areas:** Document metadata, user identity fields, timestamps, processing duration, and action availability states.
* **Avoid:** Hardcoding screenshot-specific filenames, names, dates, durations, or any business records as mock data.

### 2. Page Skeleton (Top to Bottom)

* **Section Name:** Top Page Header  
  * **Purpose:** Display the current module/page title.
  * **Container:** Full-width horizontal bar, deep navy background, fixed height around 38–44px.
  * **Children:**
    * Left-aligned page title: `创新性分析历史记录`.
  * **Style Notes:**
    * Title is white, bold, large.
    * Minimal padding on left, approximately 8–12px.
    * No icons or secondary controls in the header.

* **Section Name:** Record Toolbar  
  * **Purpose:** Show total record count and provide document search.
  * **Container:** Full-width white row, height around 70–74px, flex layout.
  * **Children:**
    * Left: record count summary text, e.g. “共 X 条记录”.
    * Right: search input and search button grouped horizontally.
      * Text input with placeholder for document name search.
      * Primary blue search button labeled `搜索`.
  * **Style Notes:**
    * Toolbar content is vertically centered.
    * Search input has light gray border, rounded corners around 4px.
    * Search button uses filled blue background, white text, rounded corners.
    * Large empty space between count text and search group using flex distribution.

* **Section Name:** History Records Table  
  * **Purpose:** Display analysis history records and available row-level actions.
  * **Container:** Full-width table on white surface.
  * **Children:**
    * Table header row.
    * Table body rows.
    * Row action button cluster.
    * Status cell.
  * **Style Notes:**
    * Header background is deep navy.
    * Header text is white and bold.
    * Body rows alternate very subtle white/light gray backgrounds or have horizontal dividers.
    * Row height is consistent and moderately dense.
    * Table spans full page width.
    * Columns are aligned on a shared grid.

* **Section Name:** Pagination Area  
  * **Purpose:** Navigate between pages of records.
  * **Container:** White horizontal row below table, centered content, height around 70px.
  * **Children:**
    * Page indicator text, e.g. “第 X / Y 页”.
    * Previous page button.
    * Next page button.
  * **Style Notes:**
    * Pagination controls are centered.
    * Previous button appears secondary/outlined gray.
    * Next button appears primary filled blue.
    * Buttons have rounded corners around 6px and fixed widths.

* **Section Name:** Modal Demo/State Label Strip  
  * **Purpose:** Indicates the currently shown interaction state.
  * **Container:** Pale blue-gray strip across the page.
  * **Children:**
    * Left-aligned label text: `提交导师审阅 · 弹窗`.
  * **Style Notes:**
    * This appears like a design-state annotation or section label.
    * Background is light blue-gray.
    * Text is bold dark navy.
    * Should not be treated as part of the runtime table unless intentionally needed.

* **Section Name:** Modal Overlay  
  * **Purpose:** Dim the page and focus user attention on the submit-for-review dialog.
  * **Container:** Full-screen or viewport-covering overlay below the annotation strip; gray translucent background.
  * **Children:**
    * Centered modal dialog.
  * **Style Notes:**
    * Overlay color is medium gray with opacity.
    * Background content remains visible but visually disabled.

* **Section Name:** Submit Review Modal  
  * **Purpose:** Allow the user to submit a selected document to a supervisor/advisor for review.
  * **Container:** Centered modal panel, approximately 66% page width, white background, rounded corners around 8–10px, slight shadow.
  * **Children:**
    * Modal header.
    * Modal form body.
    * Modal footer actions.
  * **Style Notes:**
    * Modal width around 840–860px in the screenshot context.
    * Modal has strong top header bar in navy.
    * Bottom corners rounded.
    * Modal body is spacious compared with table density.

* **Section Name:** Modal Header  
  * **Purpose:** Identify the dialog and provide close affordance.
  * **Container:** Full-width deep navy bar, height around 52px.
  * **Children:**
    * Left title: `提交导师审阅`.
    * Right close icon, visually an “×”.
  * **Style Notes:**
    * Title is white, bold, around 20px.
    * Close icon is light blue/white, thin stroke, right aligned.
    * Header padding around 32px horizontally.

* **Section Name:** Modal Body/Form  
  * **Purpose:** Display selected document and collect submission information.
  * **Container:** White form area with centered form grid.
  * **Children:**
    * Read-only document name row.
      * Label: `文档名称`.
      * Value text rendered bold/dark.
    * Select field row.
      * Label: `选择导师`.
      * Dropdown input with placeholder.
    * Textarea row.
      * Label: `备注信息`.
      * Multi-line optional notes input.
  * **Style Notes:**
    * Form is label-left, control-right layout.
    * Labels are fixed-width and right/left aligned consistently.
    * Controls are wide, approximately 470px.
    * Inputs have light gray borders and subtle rounded corners.
    * Placeholder text is light gray.
    * Dropdown uses a small downward caret on the right.
    * Textarea height around 70px.

* **Section Name:** Modal Footer Actions  
  * **Purpose:** Confirm or cancel the submission.
  * **Container:** Bottom area of modal body, centered horizontal button group.
  * **Children:**
    * Secondary cancel button: `取消`.
    * Primary/important submit button: `确认提交`.
  * **Style Notes:**
    * Buttons are large, around 160–190px wide and 44–48px high.
    * Cancel button is white/outlined with gray border.
    * Confirm button is filled orange with white bold text.
    * Gap between buttons around 28–32px.

---

### 3. Data Presentation Style

* **Pattern Type:** History records table.
* **Visual Structure:**
  * Full-width table with a dark header and multiple body rows.
  * Columns:
    * `文档名称`
    * `检测类别`
    * `报告生成时间`
    * `操作`
    * `提交状态`
  * The action column contains several compact buttons arranged horizontally.
  * The status column displays short state text, sometimes with a secondary date line.
* **Field Types:**
  * Document/file display name.
  * Analysis/check category label.
  * Generated timestamp.
  * Row-level document/report actions.
  * Submission status and optional submission date.
* **Styling Rules:**
  * Document names should be left aligned and visually prominent but not colored like links unless clickable.
  * Category and timestamp columns use muted dark gray text.
  * Action buttons are compact outlined pills/rounded rectangles:
    * Neutral gray outline for original document download.
    * Blue outline for report preview.
    * Green outline for report download.
    * Orange outline for submit/review action.
    * Disabled action uses gray border and gray text.
  * Status:
    * Submitted status uses green text, bold, with optional date beneath on a second line.
    * Unsubmitted status uses muted gray text.
  * Rows should have light dividers and consistent height.
  * Long document names should truncate with ellipsis or wrap only if necessary; table height should remain stable.
* **Do Not Copy Actual Values:**
  * Actual document names, timestamps, submission dates, and individual status values from the screenshot should remain runtime-driven.

* **Pattern Type:** Pagination.
* **Visual Structure:**
  * Centered page count indicator with previous/next controls.
* **Field Types:**
  * Current page number.
  * Total page count.
  * Navigation availability.
* **Styling Rules:**
  * Current page indicator uses neutral text.
  * Disabled/unavailable page navigation should appear gray or outlined.
  * Primary available navigation can use filled blue.

* **Pattern Type:** Modal form.
* **Visual Structure:**
  * Read-only selected document summary.
  * Dropdown selector.
  * Optional text area.
  * Confirm/cancel actions.
* **Field Types:**
  * Selected document name.
  * Advisor/supervisor selection.
  * Optional notes/remarks.
* **Styling Rules:**
  * Selected document value should be bold and dark.
  * Inputs use consistent width and border styling.
  * Required/important submission action is orange.
  * Form values should be populated from runtime state, not hardcoded.

---

### 4. Interaction Surfaces

* **Search Input**
  * Single-line text input for filtering by document name.
  * Right-aligned in toolbar.
  * Light border, white background, rounded corners.
  * Placeholder text should be light gray.
  * Should support empty and typed states.

* **Search Button**
  * Primary blue filled button.
  * White label `搜索`.
  * Rounded corners.
  * Used to trigger filtering.

* **Table Row Buttons**
  * `原文下载`: secondary neutral outlined button.
  * `报告预览`: blue outlined action.
  * `报告下载`: green outlined action.
  * `提交审阅`: orange outlined action when enabled; gray disabled style when unavailable.
  * Buttons should be visually compact and evenly spaced.
  * Disabled buttons should not have active hover emphasis.

* **Pagination Controls**
  * Previous page button uses gray/outlined secondary style.
  * Next page button uses blue filled primary style when available.
  * Page indicator remains plain text.
  * Disabled navigation state should reduce contrast.

* **Submit Review Modal**
  * Opens from the row-level `提交审阅` action.
  * Uses dimmed overlay.
  * Can be closed via:
    * Top-right close icon.
    * `取消` button.
    * Successful `确认提交`.
  * Contains:
    * Read-only document name display.
    * Advisor dropdown selector.
    * Optional remarks textarea.
  * `确认提交` is the strongest action and uses filled orange styling.
  * Validation/feedback areas are not visible but should be supported near fields or modal footer if needed.

---

### 5. Frontend Requirements Summary

* **Must Preserve:**
  * Deep navy page/header and table-header styling.
  * White admin-console surface with medium-density data table.
  * Left record count and right search toolbar layout.
  * Dark table header with white bold labels.
  * Row-level action cluster with color-coded outlined buttons.
  * Green submitted status and gray unsubmitted status.
  * Centered pagination below the table.
  * Modal overlay pattern with navy modal header, white body, and orange confirm action.
  * Label-left/control-right modal form layout.

* **Runtime-Driven Areas:**
  * Record count.
  * Table rows and all cell values.
  * Document names.
  * Detection/analysis category values.
  * Generated timestamps.
  * Button enabled/disabled state.
  * Submission status and status date.
  * Current page and total page count.
  * Selected document in modal.
  * Advisor dropdown options.
  * Notes field content.

* **Avoid:**
  * Hardcoding screenshot-specific document names, timestamps, submission dates, or statuses.
  * Treating table records as seed data.
  * Copying individual row values into implementation.
  * Building the modal as static-only content; it should be controlled by user interaction and runtime row selection.

visual_reference.label: 创新性分析报告基本信息
visual_reference.analysis:
### 1. Frontend Style Direction
* **Colors:**
  * Primary header: deep navy blue, approx `#1F3F63`.
  * Active tab / focus border / score emphasis: bright blue, approx `#2F86F6`.
  * Secondary tab background: very light blue-gray, approx `#EEF3F8`.
  * Page background: near-white / light gray, approx `#F7F9FB`.
  * Card surface: white to very pale gray, approx `#FFFFFF` / `#FAFBFC`.
  * Borders and dividers: light gray, approx `#E5E8EC`.
  * Positive badge / high-level result: green, approx `#27B46A`.
  * Muted labels: medium gray, approx `#8A8F98`.
  * Primary text: dark charcoal / navy, approx `#1F2D3D`.

* **Typography:**
  * Chinese UI font stack: system sans-serif such as `Microsoft YaHei`, `PingFang SC`, `Noto Sans SC`, `Arial`, sans-serif.
  * Page title: large, bold, centered, approx 28–32px.
  * Tab labels: medium weight, approx 16–18px.
  * Section title: bold, approx 17–18px.
  * Field labels: regular/medium, approx 15–16px, muted gray.
  * Field values: bold, approx 16–17px, dark.
  * Score value: oversized, bold, approx 40–46px, bright blue.
  * Badge text: bold, approx 22–24px, white.

* **Spacing Rhythm:**
  * Medium-density enterprise layout.
  * Strong horizontal alignment and grid-based spacing.
  * Main content has approx 18–24px side margins.
  * Card padding approx 20–24px.
  * Form rows approx 52–56px tall with thin horizontal dividers.
  * Tabs are compact, approx 40px tall.
  * Summary score panel separated from information card by approx 18–20px.

* **Overall Tone:**
  * Formal academic / administrative report dashboard.
  * Clean, data-driven, structured, institutional style.
  * Emphasis is placed on report identity, tab navigation, basic metadata, and final evaluation summary.

---

### 2. Page Skeleton 渲染结构

* **Section Name:** Page Root
* **Purpose:** Host the full innovation analysis report page.
* **Container:** Full-width responsive page, light neutral background, vertical layout.
* **Children:**
  * Header Bar
  * Tab Navigation
  * Content Area
* **Style Notes:** Layout should remain centered and horizontally stretched; no decorative imagery; emphasis comes from color blocks, borders, and typography.

---

* **Section Name:** Header Bar
* **Purpose:** Display the report title as global page identity.
* **Container:** Full-width horizontal bar, fixed height approx 60–68px, deep navy background.
* **Children:**
  * Centered title text: “学位论文创新性分析报告”
* **Style Notes:**
  * Title is horizontally centered and vertically aligned.
  * White bold text.
  * No left logo or right actions visible.
  * Header should span entire viewport width.

---

* **Section Name:** Tab Navigation
* **Purpose:** Provide report-section navigation.
* **Container:** Full-width horizontal tab strip below header, height approx 40px.
* **Children:**
  * Tab item: “基本信息”
  * Tab item: “核心指标雷达图”
  * Tab item: “子指标热力图”
  * Tab item: “分项评价”
  * Tab item: “综合评价与建议”
* **Style Notes:**
  * Tabs are equally distributed across available width.
  * Active tab uses bright blue background with white bold text.
  * Inactive tabs use pale gray-blue background with muted gray text.
  * Thin white or light divider lines separate tab items.
  * No icons shown.
  * Tab height is compact and rectangular, no rounded corners.

---

* **Section Name:** Content Area
* **Purpose:** Display the selected report section.
* **Container:** Full-width content region with pale background.
* **Children:**
  * Section Heading Bar
  * Basic Information Card
  * Comprehensive Result Panel
* **Style Notes:**
  * Vertical stacking.
  * Content begins immediately below navigation.
  * Top section heading sits on a light gray-blue strip.

---

* **Section Name:** Section Heading Bar
* **Purpose:** Identify the current subsection.
* **Container:** Full-width light gray-blue background strip, height approx 48–52px.
* **Children:**
  * Left-aligned heading text: “第一部分 · 基本信息”
* **Style Notes:**
  * Heading has dark navy color and bold weight.
  * Left padding approx 18–20px.
  * Text vertically centered.
  * Minimal visual decoration.

---

* **Section Name:** Basic Information Card
* **Purpose:** Present report metadata and document-related fields.
* **Container:** Rounded rectangle card inside content area.
  * Width: almost full width with approx 22–24px horizontal margin.
  * Background: very light / white.
  * Border: thin light gray.
  * Border radius: approx 10–12px.
  * Padding: approx 20px horizontal.
* **Children:**
  * Metadata row group
    * Row 1: document title field on left; student name field on right.
    * Row 2: first-level discipline/category field on left; degree level field on right.
    * Row 3: second-level discipline/domain field on left.
    * Row 4: research direction field on left.
    * Row 5: keywords field on left.
    * Row 6: report generation time field on left.
* **Style Notes:**
  * Two-column layout appears only where paired fields exist.
  * Left column occupies larger width, right column is narrower and aligned around the right half.
  * Field labels use muted gray.
  * Field values use darker, bold text.
  * Each row has a thin horizontal divider except potentially the final edge.
  * Row content is vertically centered.
  * Long textual values should remain single-line where possible and truncate with ellipsis if needed.
  * Do not hardcode screenshot-specific metadata values; values must be runtime-driven.

---

* **Section Name:** Comprehensive Result Panel
* **Purpose:** Summarize final innovation rating and score.
* **Container:** Full-width-style panel within page margins, below metadata card.
  * Background: pale blue, approx `#EAF4FF`.
  * Border: bright blue, approx 2px.
  * Border radius: approx 4–6px.
  * Height: approx 94–100px.
  * Horizontal layout.
* **Children:**
  * Left result block
    * Small centered label: “综合创新性等级”
    * Large green pill/badge displaying runtime grade category.
  * Center vertical divider
  * Right score block
    * Small centered label: “综合创新得分”
    * Large numeric score with small unit and denominator text.
* **Style Notes:**
  * Panel is split into two equal-width halves.
  * Center divider is thin vertical blue-gray line.
  * Left block aligns content center.
  * Green badge has rounded corners approx 8px, fixed minimum width, and generous horizontal padding.
  * Score number is oversized, blue, bold.
  * Score unit text is smaller but blue; denominator text is gray.
  * Grade and score must be data-driven.

---

### 3. Data Presentation Style

* **Pattern Type:** Metadata Detail Card
* **Visual Structure:**
  * Card-based key-value presentation.
  * Rows separated by subtle horizontal rules.
  * Mixed one-column and two-column row layout.
  * Labels precede values inline.
* **Field Types:**
  * Document/report title.
  * Student/person name.
  * Discipline/category.
  * Degree level.
  * Academic/professional domain.
  * Research direction.
  * Keywords/tags represented as comma-separated text.
  * Generated timestamp.
* **Styling Rules:**
  * Labels: muted gray, medium size.
  * Values: dark, bold, higher emphasis.
  * Long values: truncate with ellipsis or wrap only if responsive width requires it.
  * Date/time values: displayed inline using consistent timestamp formatting.
  * Right-side fields align with the visual grid rather than floating to page edge.
* **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** All metadata values should be provided by runtime data.

---

* **Pattern Type:** Summary Evaluation Panel
* **Visual Structure:**
  * Two-column summary panel.
  * Left column displays categorical grade.
  * Right column displays numeric score.
  * Vertical divider separates the two metrics.
* **Field Types:**
  * Innovation grade/category.
  * Innovation score.
  * Score unit and maximum denominator.
* **Styling Rules:**
  * Grade category uses prominent rounded green badge for positive/high status.
  * Other grade states may use semantic badge colors if needed:
    * Excellent/high: green.
    * Medium/normal: blue or amber.
    * Low/risk: orange/red.
  * Numeric score is the largest visual element in the panel.
  * Unit and denominator are visually subordinate to the number.
  * All score content is centered within the right column.
* **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** Grade label and score should be bound to live analysis result data.

---

### 4. Interaction Surfaces

* **Tab Navigation**
  * Primary interaction surface for switching report sections.
  * Active tab uses bright blue fill and white text.
  * Inactive tabs use pale gray-blue fill and muted text.
  * Hover state should slightly brighten inactive tab or darken text.
  * Tab layout should preserve equal widths.

* **Metadata Card**
  * Primarily read-only display.
  * No edit controls visible.
  * If values are missing, use a muted placeholder such as empty dash styling rather than leaving layout broken.
  * Long values should support tooltip or full-text expansion if required by implementation.

* **Summary Evaluation Panel**
  * Read-only result display.
  * Grade badge and score are emphasis components, not buttons.
  * If loading, preserve panel dimensions and use skeleton placeholders.
  * If no score is available, show muted empty state in the same layout.

* **Responsive Behavior**
  * On wide screens: preserve two-column metadata rows and two-column result panel.
  * On narrower screens: metadata rows may stack into single-column rows; result panel may stack vertically while preserving label/value hierarchy.
  * Header and tabs should remain full width.

---

### 5. Frontend Requirements Summary

* **Must Preserve:**
  * Deep navy full-width title header.
  * Equal-width horizontal tab navigation with one active blue tab.
  * Light gray-blue section heading strip.
  * Rounded metadata card with key-value rows and subtle dividers.
  * Muted labels paired with bold dark runtime values.
  * Pale blue bordered summary panel split into two centered metric blocks.
  * Green rounded grade badge and oversized blue score typography.
  * Enterprise/report-oriented clean visual hierarchy.

* **Runtime-Driven Areas:**
  * All document metadata values.
  * Person-related values.
  * Academic category/domain values.
  * Research direction and keyword content.
  * Generated timestamp.
  * Innovation grade.
  * Innovation score and score denominator if configurable.
  * Tab content for non-active sections.

* **Avoid:**
  * Hardcoding screenshot-specific names, document titles, dates, discipline values, keywords, scores, or report records.
  * Treating the screenshot values as mock business data.
  * Replacing structured key-value layout with ungrouped paragraphs.
  * Over-decorating with icons, charts, shadows, or imagery not present in this layout.
  * Changing the active tab visual hierarchy or the centered report-title treatment.

系统内置以下可执行规则：
- 章节顺序：摘要、关键词、引言、结论、参考文献必须出现，且按该顺序排列。
- 标点配对：检查中英文圆括号、方括号、书名号和引号是否成对。
- 重复标点：报告“，，”“。。”“；；”和连续三个以上相同标点。
- 日期格式：数字日期仅接受 YYYY-MM-DD，例如 2026-08-03。
- 参考文献：“参考文献”后的非空行必须以 [1] 开始并连续递增。
- 文本质量：报告连续重复词、Tab、行尾空格、超过 120 个字符的句子，以及规则表中的禁用词。
每条问题输出 rule_id、类别、严重程度、行号、列号、原文片段、问题说明和修改建议。

scenarios.name: 检出可重复的文本问题

steps.content: 文本包含未配对括号、“。。”和一个超过 120 字符的句子。
学生对该文本运行默认规则。
系统分别返回配对、重复标点和过长句问题，且每条问题包含行列位置。

FEAT-NORMATIVE-REPORT.name: 规范检测记录与报告
FEAT-NORMATIVE-REPORT.description: 学生仅查看本人的历史记录。列表按创建时间倒序展示文档名、问题总数、严重/一般/轻微计数和检测时间。\n报告页左侧显示带行号的纯文本，右侧显示问题列表；点击问题后滚动到对应行并高亮文本片段。支持下载 UTF-8 JSON 报告和使用浏览器打印页面。

images.label: 规范性检测历史记录与报告操作

steps.content: student01 拥有一份包含行列位置的已完成报告。
学生打开报告、点击一条问题并下载 JSON。
原文滚动到对应行并高亮，下载文件包含规则快照和完整问题列表。

FEAT-POLISH-HISTORY.name: 润色历史记录
FEAT-POLISH-HISTORY.description: 学生查看本人全文与局部润色记录，按时间倒序显示名称、档位、变更数和生成时间，并可查看差异或下载 .txt 结果。

images.label: 全文润色历史记录

steps.content: student01 和另一学生都有润色记录。
student01 打开历史页。
页面仅展示 student01 的记录。

FEAT-POLISH-LOCAL.name: 局部文本润色与差异对比
FEAT-POLISH-LOCAL.description: 页面左右分栏展示原文和结果，支持选择档位、处理、复制结果、重置和重试。相同原文、档位和规则版本的重试必须产生相同结果。

images.label: 局部文本左右分栏润色界面

steps.content: 学生已用标准优化处理一段文本，规则版本未变。
学生点击重试。
新结果和变更列表与上一次完全一致。

FEAT-POLISH-WHOLE.name: 全文规则润色
FEAT-POLISH-WHOLE.description:
支持粘贴文本或上传 .txt/.md，提供三档可解释处理：
- 基础校准：去除行尾空格、归一化连续空白、修复重复标点和连续重复词。
- 标准优化：在基础校准上，应用管理员维护的“原短语→替换短语”映射。
- 增强优化：在标准优化上，对超过 120 字符且包含分号或逗号的句子按首个合法分隔位置拆分，并记录拆分原因。
结果保存原文、新文、档位和变更列表，可下载 UTF-8 .txt 结果。

images.label: 全文润色文档上传与三档等级选择
全文润色完成信息与结果操作
带 Word 修订痕迹的润色输出

scenarios.name: 生成可追溯全文润色结果

steps.content: 文本包含重复标点、重复词和一个已配置的短语。
student01 选择标准优化并执行。
系统生成确定的新文和变更列表，每条变更包含原文、新文、位置和规则。

FEAT-QUALITY-DASHBOARD.name: 群体质量仪表盘
FEAT-QUALITY-DASHBOARD.description: 规范分=max(0,100-严重错误×10-一般错误×4-轻微错误×1)；原创参考分=100-本地总相似率×100；创新参考分=创新性量表综合分；评阅基础分=辅助评阅客观总分。\n群体页按权限范围和时间、学生、类型筛选，展示样本数、四指标平均分和分布图。某学生缺失某项时显示“暂无数据”，不用 0 分替代。

steps.content: 名下学生拥有规范、相似度和创新性结果，但暂无辅助评阅。
导师打开质量仪表盘。
系统按公式显示三项分数，评阅基础分显示“暂无数据”且不计入平均。

FEAT-REPORT-STUDENT-RESULTS.name: 学生查看批阅结果
FEAT-REPORT-STUDENT-RESULTS.description: 学生查看本人所有提交轮次，按时间、报告类型和状态筛选。详情页展示原报告、对应 finding 批注、整体评价、整改建议和历史轮次。\n学生首次打开已反馈结果时，状态更新为学生已查阅。支持下载包含报告摘要、批注和评价的 JSON 文件。

scenarios.name: 查看反馈并更新已查阅状态

steps.content: student01 有一条状态为批阅完成已反馈的提交记录。
学生首次打开详情。
页面展示原报告、批注和整体评价，记录状态更新为学生已查阅。

FEAT-REPORT-STUDENT-SUBMIT.name: 学生提交本人报告
FEAT-REPORT-STUDENT-SUBMIT.description: 学生可选择一条或多条已完成且属于本人的报告提交。后端通过当前用户 supervisor_id 确定导师，为每批次创建独立提交记录和站内待办。

images.label: 学生报告提交与批阅结果台账

scenarios.name: 提交报告并创建导师待办

steps.content: student01 拥有一条已完成报告，本地导师为 supervisor01。
学生提交报告。
系统创建状态为已提交待批阅的记录，并为 supervisor01 创建站内待办。
报告不属于 student01。
student01 尝试提交该报告 ID。
后端返回 403，不创建提交记录或待办。

FEAT-REPORT-SUPERVISOR-QUEUE.name: 导师站内待批阅任务
FEAT-REPORT-SUPERVISOR-QUEUE.description: 导师仅查看 assignee_id 为本人的待办，按待批阅优先、提交时间倒序排列，支持按学生、报告类型和状态筛选。红点数量来自未完成待办记录计数。

steps.content: 数据库中有分配给 supervisor01 和其他导师的待办。
supervisor01 打开待批阅中心。
页面和未读计数仅基于 supervisor01 的待办。

FEAT-REPORT-SUPERVISOR-REVIEW.name: 导师在线批阅与反馈
FEAT-REPORT-SUPERVISOR-REVIEW.description: 导师可打开原报告，对具体 finding_id 添加批注，或添加整体评价和整改建议。提交时必须至少包含一条整体评价，提交后锁定本轮内容、完成待办并将状态改为批阅完成已反馈。

images.label: 导师在线交互式报告批阅界面

steps.content: supervisor01 拥有一条待批阅任务。
导师添加一条问题批注和整体评价后提交。
系统锁定批阅内容、完成待办并将提交状态更新为批阅完成已反馈。
提交记录的 assignee_id 不是 supervisor01。
supervisor01 请求该提交记录或提交批阅。
后端返回 403，不返回报告且不修改状态。

FEAT-RULE-TEMPLATE-UPLOAD.name: JSON 规则集导入
FEAT-RULE-TEMPLATE-UPLOAD.description: 学校或学院管理人员上传不超过 1 MB 的 UTF-8 JSON 文件导入规则草稿。顶层必须为数组，每项必须包含 rule_id、title、category、severity、enabled 和 message，可选 params。\n导入仅保存草稿，不自动生效；不支持从 DOC/DOCX 模板自动推导规则。

steps.content: 管理员准备了包含两条完整规则的 JSON 数组。
管理员导入文件。
系统校验字段并创建两条草稿，不改变已生效规则。

scenarios.name: 拒绝非法 JSON 规则集

steps.content: JSON 项缺少 rule_id 或 severity 不在严重、一般、轻微之中。
管理员导入文件。
系统显示具体项索引和错误原因，不保存任何项。

FEAT-STUDENT-QUALITY-PORTRAIT.name: 单学生本地质量画像
FEAT-STUDENT-QUALITY-PORTRAIT.description: 从每类业务选取该学生最新一条已完成记录，展示四指标卡片、雷达图、原始结果时间和详情链接。\n综合分仅在四项都存在时计算，公式为四项等权平均；否则显示“数据不完整”并列出缺失项。学生仅查看本人，导师和管理员按组织范围查看。

images.label: 单学生规范性质量画像
单学生论文查重质量画像
单学生创新性质量画像
单学生 AI 智能评阅质量画像

scenarios.name: 四项数据完整时计算综合分

steps.content: student01 四项最新指标分别为 80、90、70、80。
学生打开本人质量画像。
系统显示四项来源和 80 分综合分。

scenarios.name: 拒绝学生查看他人画像

steps.content: student01 已登录。
学生请求另一学生的画像 ID。
后端返回 403，不返回他人指标。

FLOW-RULE-PUBLISH.name: 学校与学院规则配置
FLOW-RULE-PUBLISH.description: 规则包含 rule_id、标题、类别、严重程度、启用状态、匹配参数和提示文案。\n学校管理人员维护全校默认规则，学院管理人员仅维护本学院规则。同一 rule_id 的合并顺序为国标默认值 < 学校规则 < 学院规则；学院重置后删除学院覆盖并继承学校值。

images.label: 模板历史、模板上传与可视化规则配置界面

scenarios.name: 学院规则覆盖学校规则

steps.content: 学校已发布 rule_id 为 TEXT-LONG-SENTENCE 的 120 字符阈值。
college01 管理员将同一规则改为 100 字符并提交生效。
college01 学生检测使用 100，其他学院仍使用 120。
college_admin01 属于 college01。
该用户尝试修改 college02 的规则。
后端返回 403，且 college02 规则不变。

MOD-AI-REVIEW.name: 规则化论文辅助评阅
MOD-AI-REVIEW.description: 基于固定评阅模板和可验证的文本特征生成辅助检查结果。系统检查章节、篇幅、参考文献数量、方法与结论章节及规范问题，主观学术质量统一标记为“待人工确认”。\n本版本不调用外部大模型，不产生专家级学术结论。

MOD-AUTH.name: 本地身份认证与会话
MOD-AUTH.description: 使用本地 SQLite 用户、密码哈希和服务端会话完成认证。系统提供四类可测试角色账号，并在本地数据中保存学生—导师—学院的组织关系。\njAccount、短信验证码、交我办和微信扫码不属于本版本实现与验收范围。

images.label: 统一身份认证界面参考

MOD-DUPLICATION-CHECK.name: 本地文本相似度与写作风险检测
MOD-DUPLICATION-CHECK.description: 对纯文本执行本地可解释检测。“校内相似度”仅与学校管理人员已导入的本地样本库比对；“写作风险”仅根据重复率、句长分布和模板短语密度输出风险提示，不声称识别 AI 生成真伪。

MOD-INNOVATION-ANALYSIS.name: 创新性量表评估
MOD-INNOVATION-ANALYSIS.description: 通过用户填写的五维度等级和证据文本生成透明可解释的创新性自评结果。系统不搜索国内外文献，不访问往届论文库，不声称自动发现学术创新。

MOD-LEDGER.name: 本地检测台账与统计
MOD-LEDGER.description: 聚合本系统 SQLite 中真实存在的规范检测、相似度检测、规则润色、创新性量表和辅助评阅记录。统计在打开页面、更改筛选条件或点击刷新时重新计算，不承诺无延迟实时流处理。

MOD-NORMATIVE-DETECTION.name: 论文规则化规范检测
MOD-NORMATIVE-DETECTION.description: 对 UTF-8 纯文本论文执行可解释、可重复的规则检测。系统支持 .txt 和 .md 文件或直接粘贴文本，单份内容不超过 5 MB。\n检测范围包括章节完整性、标点配对、连续重复标点、数字与日期的有限规则、参考文献顺序编码、禁用词典、重复词和过长句。不检测 Word/PDF 的字体、页边距、页码或页眉页脚。

MOD-POLISH.name: 规则化文本润色
MOD-POLISH.description: 使用本地确定性规则修正空白、标点、重复词和可配置短语，并用差异视图展示每处变更。\n本版本不调用外部大模型，不声称进行语义重构，不生成 Word 原生修订痕迹。

MOD-QUALITY-PORTRAIT.name: 本地论文质量仪表盘与画像
MOD-QUALITY-PORTRAIT.description: 使用本系统已生成的四类可量化结果计算质量指标，不引入新的 AI 判断。所有公式在页面中公开，且可追溯到原始记录。

MOD-REPORT-INTERACTION.name: 本地师生报告交互批阅
MOD-REPORT-INTERACTION.description: 学生将本系统内已完成的规范检测、相似度、创新性量表或辅助评阅报告提交给本地组织关系中的导师。\n“推送”指在 SQLite 中创建站内待办，不发送短信、邮件或外部消息。批注绑定报告 finding_id 或作为整体评语，不在 PDF/Word 坐标层上绘制。

SYS-DEGREE-AI-REVIEW.name: 智慧学位 AI 评阅辅助系统（ARC 可实现版）
SYS-DEGREE-AI-REVIEW.description: 面向学生、导师、学院管理人员和学校管理人员，建设一个可在当前 ARC Web 模板中完整生成、运行和测试的学位论文辅助系统。\n系统采用单端口 B/S 架构，前端使用 React，后端使用 Express，业务数据使用 SQLite 持久化。系统在本地单实例中运行，不承诺微服务拆分、校内私有云部署、高并发或弹性扩容。\n所有核心结果必须由本地可解释的规则、公式和持久化数据产生，不依赖 jAccount、短信、微信、外部大模型、校外文献库或未提供的校内论文库。

系统架构
